messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Realtime streaming (us-east-1) showing out-of-order chunks for some websocket sessions. Users may see message reordering or duplicate chunks. Investigating. https://status.redwood.example/incident/2238801234 :warning:

alesha: noticed client reports from two customers around 2238798000. Repro locally with load-tester patterns hitting long-lived streams.

sre_lead: can confirm. Metrics: reorder-rate ~0.6% on ingress MUX, spike started after 2238796500. No increased 5xxs.

oncall-ops: paging network and ingress teams. Marking SEV3 for now; escalate if customer impact widens.

infra-qa-bot: recent change: rolling restart of edge-proxy-us-east (v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2) at 2238796000 due to TLS perf fix. Rolls completed in waves.

tom: hypothesis: proxy connections are being rebalanced mid-stream during drain window and some mux IDs reused, quick fix might be to extend connection-drain timeout and force session pinning.

alesha: relevant logs (truncated):
```
[2238796123] mux: session 0x7f3a reattached to worker-12
[2238796124] mux: chunk seq 42 received out-of-order (expected 43)
[2238796130] worker-12: reset conn, reason=graceful-drain
```

support: impacted customers: AcmeSearch (prod), ThymeDocs (staging). Acme reported ordering issues in user chat flows. Support has opened tickets and added request IDs.

oncall-ops: immediate mitigations: 1) paused further edge-proxy restarts in us-east, 2) increased drain window from 5s -> 30s, 3) force session pinning on mux layer for existing connections. Applying now.

sre_lead: applied drain-window change with feature flag: `edge.proxy.drain_timeout=30s`. Also toggled `mux.session_pin=true` for us-east traffic. Monitoring.

alesha: after changes reorder-rate down to 0.08% and no new customer reports in last 12m. Keeping monitor for 45m.

tom: next steps: revert proxy rollout (v2.3.2) to v2.3.1 for us-east to validate if rollout caused issue, run canary of patched proxy with improved session handling.

oncall-ops: comms: status page updated and affected customers notified with mitigation steps. Support to reach out to AcmeSearch PM with postmortem once RCA complete.

infra-qa-bot: note to postmortem: include rollout wave timings and drain config change that landed prior to onset.

support: recording sample request IDs for AcmeSearch: rid-az3-112233, rid-az3-112244. Sharing with SRE for deeper trace.

alesha: will own RCA and produce a short internal summary within 36h. If reorder-rate creeps above 0.5% we'll reopen escalation.

incident-bot: STATUS: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2238801234 Current: mitigated, monitoring.

oncall-ops: thanks everyone. Moving to watch phase. Please update this thread when rollback/canary schedule is set. :white_check_mark:
